title: Berlin Districts - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Berlin has 12 districts (Bezirke)** since 1 January 2001, formed from 23 older ones.
**Spandau, Neukölln and Reinickendorf** kept their borders; the rest were merged in pairs or threes.
**The old names live on as Ortsteile.** Wedding, Prenzlauer Berg and Kreuzberg are localities inside a bigger district.
**Your Bezirk runs the services close to home:** Bürgeramt, Jugendamt, Ordnungsamt, Schulamt, Standesamt, libraries.
**Any Bürgeramt in Berlin** can register your address or renew your ID, not only the ones in your district.
**Residence permits, car registration and taxes** are state offices, not district ones.
**Noise, trees and broken benches** go to the district where the problem is, not where you live.
**Find your Ortsteil in the tool** to see your district, its pre-2001 name, and who handles your errand.
